scope: Same canonical geography, default quality, current V36 vs V37 implementation; V31 is historical only.
limitations: Headless Chrome at 60 Hz cannot certify 100 FPS presentation.
Main JS heap excludes Worker heaps; API buffer allocation is not measured physical VRAM.
Camera jumps between saved scenarios remain in the frame measurements.
Cold starts use fresh browser storage; OS and HTTP cache are not purged. Warm repeats keep the page and Worker pools alive.
CPU and GPU timings overlap and are not added.
Local reference region uses a canonical cubic profile; sharp hydro/biome boundaries intentionally fall back to the generator.
Separate far static-shadow texture cache and temporal vertex morph are not implemented. Active transition memory limits remain soft to retain valid surface.
